summary: JC converts output of many CLI tools into dicts and is available as the community.general.jc filter, for example parsing dig output.
questions: How can I parse dig output in Ansible?

answer_card.title: Parse command output with jc
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- shell: dig example.com
  register: result
- set_fact:
    myvar: "{{ result.stdout | community.general.jc('dig') }}"
- debug:
    msg: "The IP is: {{ myvar[0].answer[0].data }}"
```
`jc` handles dozens of Linux/UNIX/macOS/Windows tools.
